classification.difficultyReason: Infer a suitable rotation or reflection from corresponding vertices, choose its centre or axis, then determine and verify the translation needed to complete the mapping.

content.prompt: In each part, describe two successive transformations that will have the combined effect of moving $\triangle ABC$ onto $\triangle A''B''C''$.

spec.description: Two unfilled labelled triangles on an eight-by-eight unit grid, retaining darker reference grid lines.
spec.mathematics: Grid coordinates from bottom left: A=(1,5), B=(1,1), C=(4,1); A''=(8,5), B''=(4,5), C''=(4,2). Coordinates are construction data and are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Both triangles are permanent supplied givens.

answer.short: One possible answer: rotate $90^\circ$ clockwise about $B$, then translate 3 units right and 4 units up.
answer.worked:
Rotate $\triangle ABC$ through $90^\circ$ clockwise about $B$. The image of $A$ lies 4 units right of $B$, and the image of $C$ lies 3 units below $B$.

Translate this triangle 3 units right and 4 units up. Its vertices now coincide with $A''$, $B''$ and $C''$, respectively.

spec.description: Two unfilled labelled triangles on an eight-by-eight unit grid, retaining darker reference grid lines.
spec.mathematics: A=(3,4), B=(2,1), C=(6,1); A''=(3,5), B''=(6,6), C''=(6,2). No coordinate axes or numerical coordinates are printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Both triangles are permanent supplied givens.

answer.short: One possible answer: reflect in the line $AC$, then translate 1 unit up.
answer.worked:
Reflect $\triangle ABC$ in the line $AC$. Points $A$ and $C$ stay fixed; the reflected image of $B$ lies 4 units directly above $C$.

Translate the reflected triangle 1 unit up. The three vertices coincide with $A''$, $B''$ and $C''$.

spec.description: Two unfilled labelled triangles on an eight-by-eight unit grid, retaining darker reference grid lines.
spec.answerVisibility: Both triangles are permanent supplied givens.

answer.short: One possible answer: reflect in the line $BC$, then translate 2 units right and 3 units up.
answer.worked:
Reflect $\triangle ABC$ in the vertical line $BC$. Points $B$ and $C$ stay fixed; the reflected image of $A$ lies 2 units right of $B$.

Translate the reflected triangle 2 units right and 3 units up. Its vertices coincide with $A''$, $B''$ and $C''$.

spec.description: Two unfilled triangles on an eight-by-eight unit grid. The shared vertex retains the joint label C, A''.
spec.answerVisibility: Both triangles and the coincident-vertex label are permanent supplied givens.

answer.short: One possible answer: rotate $90^\circ$ clockwise about $C$, then translate 1 unit down.
answer.worked:
Rotate $\triangle ABC$ through $90^\circ$ clockwise about $C$. The image of $A$ lies 1 unit above $C$, and the image of $B$ lies 4 units right and 1 unit above $C$.

Translate the rotated triangle 1 unit down. Its vertices coincide with $A''$, $B''$ and $C''$.
